DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物の特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please describe the item you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さいかばんを落としました。黒だと思っていましたが、家族から写真が届いて、濃い茶色だったと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真で紛失品の色の誤りに気付いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost a small bag. I thought it was black, but my family sent a photograph and I realized it was dark brown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a photograph made you notice your description of the lost item's color was wrong. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のお話の色を訂正したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want to correct the color you just described, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。黒という説明を茶色へ直してください。写真は前に家で撮った物で、落とした場所の写真ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色を訂正し写真の撮影状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please change black to brown. The photograph was taken at home earlier, not at the place where I lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the color and explain where and when the photograph was taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 形や大きさも確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you also confirm the shape and size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横長で、肩に掛けるひもがあります。写真では隣にノートがありますが、ノートも一緒に落としたという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形を説明して写真の隣の物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is wider than it is tall and has a shoulder strap. There is a notebook next to it in the photograph, but that does not mean I lost the notebook too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the shape and distinguish the item beside it in the photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身について分かることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell me what you know about the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日入れた鍵があります。写真だけからほかの中身を決めず、入れた記憶がある物として鍵をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記憶に基づく中身を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a key I put in yesterday. Rather than determine other contents from the photograph alone, I am reporting the key as something I remember putting inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the contents based on your memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 落とした時間や場所も訂正がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any corrections to the time or place you lost it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこは変わりません。今日の午前、駅から歩いた道です。訂正するのは色で、写真に写った物すべてを紛失品には加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正する点と変わらない点を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those are unchanged: this morning, on the road I walked from the station. The correction is the color; I am not adding everything in the photograph to the lost items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize what you are correcting and what remains unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。特徴の訂正と、写真の撮影状況を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record the corrected features and the circumstances in which the photograph was taken.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙の準備で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble preparing your letters?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人へ手紙を送ります。封筒の宛名は書きましたが、中の便箋を入れ違えそうなので、閉じる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通の便箋の入違いを防ぎたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending letters to two people. I have addressed the envelopes, but might mix up the writing paper inside, so I want to check before sealing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to prevent swapping the pages of the two letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 便箋に相手のお名前はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is each recipient's name on the writing paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一方は姉への近況、もう一方は友人へのお礼です。便箋の最初に、それぞれ名前を書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手別の内容と名前の記載を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. One is news for my older sister, the other thanks for a friend. I wrote each person's name at the start of their letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the different recipients, contents, and written names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一通ずつ、宛名と便箋の名前を合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Match the envelope addressee and letter name one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず姉への封筒だけを開いて、姉の名前の便箋を入れます。友人の方はまだ横に置いたままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一通ずつ照合する手順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I will open only my sister's envelope and insert the letter with her name. I will leave my friend's one beside it for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the procedure for checking one letter at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 姉への分は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked the one for your sister?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。宛名と便箋が合いました。こちらを閉じてから、友人の封筒とお礼の便箋を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一通目を確認して二通目へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The addressee and letter match. I will seal this one before matching my friend's envelope with the thank-you letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the first letter and proceed to the second. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二通とも封をしたら、外側の宛名も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After sealing both, check the addressees on the outside again too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二通とも確認できました。封筒の中を見られなくなる前に照合しました。今は住所と郵便番号を見直してから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封入照合後に住所を見直して差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both have been checked. I matched them before I could no longer see inside the envelopes. Now I will recheck the addresses and postal codes before handing them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the enclosures, recheck the addresses and hand them over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご確認後に二通をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will accept the two letters after your checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振込みのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ今回だけ送金したいです。下書きの回数の欄に「毎月」と書きましたが、同じ額だから毎月という意味にはならないので、提出前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未提出の下書きの毎月という記載と一回の送金希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send my family money just this once. I wrote 'monthly' in the frequency field of my draft, but the same amount does not mean monthly, so I want to check before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the 'monthly' entry on the unsubmitted draft against your wish for a one-time transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ下書きですね。毎月送るお約束を、ご家族とされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is still a draft, then. Have you agreed with your family to send money every month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。今月の一回分だけを話しました。家族が毎月使う費用の補助ですが、私が毎月送る約束をしたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の毎月の用途と自分の送金回数の約束を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. We only discussed one transfer this month. It helps with an expense my family has every month, but I have not promised to send money monthly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your family's monthly use from your agreement about how often you will transfer money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取った方の使い道と、お客様が送る回数は分けてお伝えください。実際の依頼方法は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the recipient's use from how often you send money. The staff member will check how to make the actual request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今月一回だけと書き直し、繰返しの設定を申し込む希望はないと伝えます。来月以降は家族と相談してから別に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今月一回と記載し将来の送金は未定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will change it to once this month and explain that I do not want to apply for a recurring setting. I will decide separately about next month onward after talking with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write once this month and explain that future transfers are undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この下書きで、すでに手続きを頼んだことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already asked for any procedure using this draft?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。家で書いただけです。毎月という文字を消したことを、登録済みの設定の取消しが済んだこととは考えません。今日は一回の依頼方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 下書き未提出なので登録取消しではなく一回の依頼方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I only wrote it at home. I will not consider erasing the word monthly to mean that an already registered setting has been canceled. Today I will ask how to request a single transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since the draft has not been submitted, ask how to request one transfer rather than treat it as cancellation of a registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の金額と振込先も、確認できる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have information that can confirm the amount and transfer destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、家族から受け取った情報があります。金額と振込先、今回の一回という希望を担当へ示します。実行したかは案内と控えで確認してから家族へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額振込先回数を担当へ示し実行確認後に家族へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I have information from my family. I will show the staff the amount, destination, and my wish for a single transfer this time. I will tell my family only after checking the guidance and receipt to confirm execution.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the staff the amount, destination, and frequency, and inform your family after confirming execution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一回の送金をご希望で、繰返し設定は希望されないと担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the staff you want one transfer and do not want a recurring setting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つは同じ菓子ですか。大きい袋の方がたくさん入っていると思いましたが、表示を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装の大きさと中身の量を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are these two the same sweets? I thought the bigger bag held more, but want to compare the labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to compare package size and the quantity inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ種類ですが、包装が違います。内容量をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are the same kind but packaged differently. Please look at the net quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらは百グラムで、大きい方も百グラムですね。袋が大きいだけで量も多いと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両方の内容量が同じだと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is 100 grams and the bigger one is also 100 grams. I thought a larger bag meant a greater quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that both contain the same quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい方は一つずつ包んであります。どのように使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The larger one is individually wrapped. How will you use them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場で四人に分けたいです。重さだけでなく、個包装が何個あるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分ける目的と個数の確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to share them among four people at work. I want to check not just the weight but how many individually wrapped pieces there are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the purpose of sharing and the need to check the piece count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらには八個と書いてあります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら一人二個ずつ分けられます。小さい袋は家で食べる時の候補にして、今日は八個入りを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個数を人数へ割り当て品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I can give two to each person. I will keep the small bag as an option for eating at home and choose the eight-piece one today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allocate the pieces among the people and choose a product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計前に、選んだ包装であることを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before paying, check that you have selected the packaging you wanted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。袋の大きさではなく、百グラムで個包装八個という表示を確認しました。四人へ分ける分としてこちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 量と包装と用途を確認して購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I checked the label for 100 grams and eight individually wrapped pieces, rather than the bag's size. I will buy this to share among four people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the quantity, packaging, and purpose before buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの商品をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 景色を撮っていらっしゃるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are photographing the scenery, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。離れて住む家族に花の様子を見せたいです。以前の写真と混ざらないよう、今日の撮影時刻も残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の花の写真に撮影時刻を残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to show the flowers to my family who live far away. I also want to keep today's shooting time so these do not get confused with older photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to keep the shooting time with today's flower photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前にも同じ場所で撮りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you photographed this same place before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 春に撮りました。その写真を今の景色と思われないよう、今日の分は別のまとまりにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去の写真と今日の分を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: In spring. I will put today's photographs in a separate group so those older ones are not mistaken for the current scenery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the old photographs from today's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、どの景色を撮りたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which view would you like to photograph now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この花壇全体です。ただ、ここで咲いている花を公園全部の様子として紹介せず、この場所の写真と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影範囲と公園全体を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This whole flower bed. However, I will describe it as a photograph of this spot rather than present the flowers blooming here as the state of the whole park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the photographed area from the whole park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮る向きによっては、通行する人も入りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Depending on the direction, people passing by might be included too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が通る間は待ちます。家族には花壇の位置と今日撮ったことを説明し、前の写真とは日付で分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を待ち位置と日付を添えて紹介する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait while people pass. I will explain the flower bed's location and that I photographed it today, distinguishing it from previous photographs by the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for people to pass and present the location and date with the photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を送った後、昔の分も見せる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you plan to show the old ones too after sending these?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。比べる時は春の写真と今日の写真をそれぞれ明示します。花の名前は分からないので、写真から勝手に付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較する写真の時期と不明な花名を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. When comparing, I will clearly label the spring photographs and today's ones separately. I do not know the flower names, so will not assign names just from the pictures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the dates of the photographs being compared and that the flower names are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。通行を空けて撮影をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Keep the passage clear and enjoy taking photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と列車に乗ります。車内で誕生日の品を渡したいのですが、袋を何個も持っているので、乗る前にまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車前に贈り物と荷物をまとめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking a train with a friend. I want to give them a birthday present aboard, but have several bags, so want to organize them before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to organize your gift and luggage before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きい贈り物でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい箱です。ただ、別に花と自分の荷物もあります。友人に持ってもらう物と私が持つ物を決めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 贈り物と花と私物を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A small box. But I also have flowers and my own belongings separately. I will decide beforehand what my friend will carry and what I will carry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the gift, flowers, and personal belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、こちらの脇で準備できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can prepare here at the side, keeping the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。花は友人に先に渡し、箱は私のかばんへ入れます。乗る時に三つを一度に渡そうとするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花を先に渡し箱を自分で持つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will give the flowers to my friend first and put the box in my bag. I will stop trying to hand over all three things at once when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to give the flowers first and carry the box yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱は、かばんから取り出しやすい位置ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the box in an easy-to-reach place in your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。席に着いてから出せます。混んでいて座れなければ、渡すのは降りてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を渡す条件と代替の時機を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I can take it out once seated. If it is crowded and we cannot sit, I will give it after getting off instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the condition for giving the box and an alternative time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車内で包装を開ける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you plan to open the wrapping aboard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には家で開けてもらいます。車内で紙やリボンが広がらないよう、渡す時も包装のままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包装を開けず持ち物を広げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my friend to open it at home. I will hand it over still wrapped so paper and ribbons do not spread out inside the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will keep the wrapping closed and not spread belongings around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。荷物をまとめて、ご一緒にお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Organize your luggage and go ahead together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内に窓口名が二つあります。書類を出す所と質問する所が違うのか、確認してから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内の二つの窓口の役割を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice names two counters. I want to check whether the place for submitting documents differs from the place for questions before going ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the roles of the two counters on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの欄をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which sections were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上は提出先、下は問い合わせと書いてあります。同じ建物なので、どちらでも受け取ると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先と問い合わせ先を同一視したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The top says submission destination and the bottom says inquiries. Since they are in the same building, I came thinking either would accept them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you treated the submission and inquiry destinations as the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は提出と、説明の確認のどちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today, do you want to submit documents or check the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 記入方法に質問が残っています。まだ書類を完成させていないので、先に問い合わせの窓口へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未完成のため質問を先にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have a question about filling them in. I have not completed the documents, so want to go to the inquiry counter first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that because the documents are incomplete, you want to ask questions first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 質問はどの項目ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which field is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡先の欄です。ここを説明してもらってから記入し、完成した書類は案内の提出先へ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問する欄と提出までの順を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contact details field. I will have that explained, then fill it in and submit the completed documents to the destination on the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the field you want to ask about and the steps through submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出先の受付時間も案内にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The notice gives the submission counter's opening hours too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。質問が終わるころには受付が終わるかもしれないので、今日無理に提出せず、まず記入方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出時間を考えまず説明を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Reception might be closed by the time my questions are answered, so rather than force submission today, I will check the filling instructions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consider the submission hours and explain that you will get the instructions first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。問い合わせの窓口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you to the inquiry counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票を確認します。気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check your appointment slip. Is anything concerning you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 余白に「朝は何も食べない」と書いてありますが、私が家で書いたメモです。病院の指示だったか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の準備メモの出所が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a note in the margin saying 'eat nothing in the morning,' but I wrote it at home. I do not remember whether it was an instruction from the hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the source of your own preparation note is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印刷された説明とは別の書き込みですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is a handwritten addition, separate from the printed instructions, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。別の受診の話を家族とした時に書いたかもしれません。今日の正式な準備案内か、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の受診との混同の可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I might have written it while talking with my family about a different medical visit. I want to check whether it is the official preparation guidance for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the possibility of confusion with another medical visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の予約内容を担当へ照会します。今朝は食事をしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff about today's appointment. Did you eat this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いつもどおり食べました。自分のメモを正式な指示だと思って、食べていないと言うことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝の食事を事実どおり伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I ate as usual. I will not treat my own note as an official instruction and say that I did not eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report this morning's meal truthfully. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食事の内容と時刻を担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff what and when you ate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝七時にパンと卵を食べました。飲み物も取りました。今日の予約に関係するかは、担当に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事時刻と内容を担当へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I ate bread and eggs at seven this morning. I also had drinks. I will have the staff check whether that affects today's appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the meal time and contents to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認まで、予約票をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep your appointment slip until we confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が書いたメモと印刷の案内を分けて示し、今朝の食事をそのまま説明します。次の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自筆メモと正式案内を区別して確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will show my written note separately from the printed guidance and explain this morning's meal as it was. I will wait for the next instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish your handwritten note from official guidance and wait for confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした財布の件です。家族から「受け取った」とだけ連絡が来ましたが、ここで受け取ったのか分からず確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の曖昧な受取連絡を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: About my lost wallet. My family only sent a message saying 'received it,' but I do not know whether they received it here, so came to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to clarify your family's vague receipt message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族から場所や品物の説明はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your family describe the place or item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだありません。私が探しているのは赤い財布ですが、家族は今日別の荷物も受け取る予定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 探している品と家族の別の予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I am looking for a red wallet, but my family was also expecting another parcel today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the item you are seeking and your family's other plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、何をどこで受け取ったのかご家族へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you first ask your family what they received and where?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。財布のことか、予定していた荷物のことかを聞きます。短い伝言だけで財布が見付かったとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伝言の対象と受取場所を家族へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will ask whether they mean the wallet or the expected parcel. I will not conclude the wallet has been found from a short message alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your family which item the message refers to and where they received it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、こちらで必要なご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you confirm, we can hear whatever consultation you need here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。受け取ったのは宅配の荷物でした。財布のことではなかったので、紛失の相談を続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物だったと確認し紛失相談を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Their reply arrived. What they received was the delivered parcel. It was not the wallet, so I want to continue the lost-property consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that it was the parcel and continue discussing the lost item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 財布を最後に確認した場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell me where you last saw the wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日、買い物の後にかばんへ入れました。その後どこで落としたかは分かりません。家族の受取りとは別に、その経緯を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 財布を最後に確認した状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yesterday, after shopping, I put it in my bag. I do not know where I lost it afterward. I will describe that sequence separately from my family's receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the circumstances when you last confirmed the wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。財布の紛失について詳しく伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask you more about the lost wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with a letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父へ書いた手紙に、別の紙で追伸を付けたいです。短い紙だけでは誰への続きか分からなくならないか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別紙の追伸がどの手紙の続きか示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to add a postscript on a separate sheet to the letter I wrote to my grandfather. I worry that with just the short sheet, it might not be clear whose letter it continues.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to show which letter the separate postscript continues. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の紙は、同じ封筒に入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will the separate sheet go in the same envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じ封筒です。手紙は昨日書き、追伸は今日書いたので、日付も違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同封と二つの日付を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same envelope. I wrote the letter yesterday and the postscript today, so the dates are different too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both go in one envelope and have two different dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読む方が分かるよう、ご自身で内容を整えてください。発送の準備についてはお手伝いできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please arrange the contents yourself so the reader understands. We can help with preparations for sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。追伸の上に祖父の名前と「昨日の手紙の続き」と書き、今日の日付を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追伸に相手と位置付けと日付を書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. At the top of the postscript I will write my grandfather's name and 'continuation of yesterday's letter,' and add today's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the recipient, the postscript's relation to the letter, and the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙を入れる順番は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided the order to put the pages in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の手紙を先に、追伸を後ろに重ねます。追伸だけ落ちないよう、二枚あることを確認して封筒へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読み順と紙の枚数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will place yesterday's letter first and the postscript behind it. I will check there are two sheets before putting them in the envelope so the postscript is not left out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the reading order and number of sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封をした後、大きさと重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After sealing it, we will check the size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも入りました。読む順もそろえたので閉じます。宛先は祖父の住所一つで、追伸の分に別の宛先は書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を同封して一つの宛先へ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both sheets are inside. I have arranged the reading order, so will seal it. There is just one destination, my grandfather's address; I will not write a separate destination for the postscript.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enclose both sheets and send to one destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒をこちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please hand the envelope over here.
